### FUNCTION atlasParallelMarketMetalsState
function atlasParallelMarketMetalsState() {
  return state.parallelMarkets.metals;
}

### FUNCTION atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsPeriod
function atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsPeriod(period) {
  const value = Number(period);
  if (![1, 7, 30, 90, 365].includes(value)) return false;
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period = value;
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsWrite();
  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
  atlasWorkspaceRenderStrip?.();
  atlasWorkspaceScheduleSave?.(120);
  void atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationReloadHistory();
  return true;
}

### FUNCTION atlasMetalsMathCoreMetrics
function atlasMetalsMathCoreMetrics() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const asset = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal();
  const periodDays = Number(metals.period || 7);
  const periodLabel = atlasChartPeriodLabel(periodDays);
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays);
  const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(asset.id, periodDays);
  const returns = [];
  for (let index = 1; index < points.length; index += 1) {
    const previous = Number(points[index - 1].y);
    const current = Number(points[index].y);
    if (previous > 0 && current > 0) returns.push(Math.log(current / previous));
  }
  const volatilitySessionPct = returns.length >= 2
    ? atlasMetalsMathSampleStd(returns) * 100
    : null;
  const drawdown = atlasMetalsMathDrawdown(points);
  const values = points.map(point => Number(point.y)).filter(Number.isFinite);
  const low = values.length ? Math.min(...values) : null;
  const high = values.length ? Math.max(...values) : null;
  const amplitudePct = Number.isFinite(low) && low > 0 && Number.isFinite(high)
    ? ((high - low) / low) * 100
    : null;
  const completenessPct = rows.length
    ? Math.min(100, (points.length / rows.length) * 100)
    : null;
  const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, periodDays);
  const quote = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationQuote(asset.id);
  const first = points[0] || null;
  const last = points[points.length - 1] || null;
  const latestStepPct = points.length >= 2
    ? ((points[points.length - 1].y / points[points.length - 2].y) - 1) * 100
    : null;
  return {
    asset,
    periodDays,
    periodLabel,
    rows,
    points,
    returns,
    reading,
    quote,
    first,
    last,
    latestStepPct,
    volatilitySessionPct,
    drawdown,
    low,
    high,
    amplitudePct,
    completenessPct,
    ready: reading?.available === true && points.length >= 2
  };
}

### FUNCTION atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows
function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays || 365);
  if (days === 1) {
    return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradayPoints(atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id)
      .map(point => ({ time: point.x, point }));
  }
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHistoryRows();
  if (!rows.length) return [];
  const newestTime = rows[rows.length - 1].time;
  const cutoff = newestTime - Math.max(1, days) * 86400000;
  const inside = rows.filter(row => row.time >= cutoff);
  const anchor = [...rows].reverse().find(row => row.time < cutoff) || null;
  const selected = anchor ? [anchor, ...inside] : inside;
  const unique = new Map();
  selected.forEach(row => unique.set(String(row.time), row));
  return [...unique.values()].sort((left, right) => left.time - right.time);
}

### FUNCTION atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints
function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(assetId, periodDays = null) {
  if (Number(periodDays) === 1) {
    return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradayPoints(assetId);
  }
  const rows = periodDays === null
    ? atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHistoryRows()
    : atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays);
  return rows.map(row => {
    const quote = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(row.snapshot?.quotes)
      .find(item => item?.asset_id === assetId
        && String(item?.instrument_type || "") === "future_continuous");
    const price = Number(quote?.price);
    if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) return null;
    return {
      x: row.time,
      y: price,
      currency: String(quote?.currency || "USD").toUpperCase(),
      unit: String(quote?.unit || ""),
      source: "yahoo_finance"
    };
  }).filter(Boolean);
}

### FUNCTION atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationChartSeries
function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationChartSeries() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);
  const activeId = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id;
  const periodDays = Number(metals.period || 365);
  const series = [];

  for (const asset of ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS) {
    if (!selected.has(asset.id)) continue;
    // Les unités et ordres de grandeur diffèrent fortement.
    // En mode Prix, une seule échelle réelle est affichée : l'actif actif.
    // La comparaison multi-actifs est réservée au mode Base 100.
    if (metals.view !== "base100" && asset.id !== activeId) continue;
    const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(asset.id, periodDays);
    if (!points.length) continue;
    if (metals.view === "base100") {
      const base = points[0].y;
      points.forEach(point => { point.y = (point.y / base) * 100; });
    }
    series.push({
      id: asset.id,
      symbol: asset.symbol,
      color: ATLAS_METALS_CHART_COLORS[asset.id],
      points
    });
  }
  return series;
}

### FUNCTION atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading
function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(assetId, periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays);
  const intraday = days === 1;
  const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(assetId, days);
  const unitLabel = intraday ? "points Futures intraday" : "séances Futures";
  const spanHours = points.length >= 2
    ? Math.max(0, (points[points.length - 1].x - points[0].x) / 3600000)
    : 0;

  if (points.length < 2) {
    const count = points.length;
    return Object.freeze({
      available: false,
      partial: intraday && count > 0,
      state: "insufficient",
      text: intraday ? "Intraday Futures en attente" : "Historique insuffisant",
      detail: intraday
        ? `${count} point${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} Futures intraday réel${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} · première collecte GitHub Actions requise`
        : `${count} séance${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} Futures réelle${count > 1 ? "s" : ""}`,
      points: count,
      spanHours
    });
  }

  const first = points[0];
  const last = points[points.length - 1];
  const delta = last.y - first.y;
  const percent = first.y !== 0 ? (delta / first.y) * 100 : null;
  if (!Number.isFinite(percent)) {
    return Object.freeze({
      available: false,
      state: "incoherent",
      text: "Variation non calculable",
      detail: `${points.length} ${unitLabel}`,
      points: points.length,
      spanHours
    });
  }

  const sign = percent > 0 ? "+" : "";
  const formatted = new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(percent);
  const dateOptions = intraday
    ? { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }
    : undefined;
  return Object.freeze({
    available: true,
    state: percent > 0 ? "up" : percent < 0 ? "down" : "stable",
    text: `${sign}${formatted} % · ${points.length} ${unitLabel}`,
    detail: `${new Date(first.x).toLocaleString("fr-FR", dateOptions)} → ${new Date(last.x).toLocaleString("fr-FR", dateOptions)}`,
    percent,
    delta,
    points: points.length,
    first,
    last,
    spanHours,
    source: intraday ? "yahoo_finance_futures_intraday" : "yahoo_finance_futures_daily"
  });
}

### FUNCTION atlasMetalsHumanReadingPeriodLabel
function atlasMetalsHumanReadingPeriodLabel(periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays || 7);
  if (days === 1) return "24 heures";
  if (days === 365) return "1 an";
  return `${days} jours`;
}

### FUNCTION atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderHumanReading
function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderHumanReading(assetId = null, periodDays = null) {
  const card = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReading");
  const title = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingTitle");
  const period = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingPeriod");
  const state = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingState");
  const summary = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingSummary");
  const context = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingContext");
  const source = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingSource");
  if (!card || !title || !period || !state || !summary || !context || !source) return false;

  const asset = atlasMarketRegistryAssetMeta(
    String(assetId || atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal()?.id || "gold")
  );
  const days = Number(periodDays ?? atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period ?? 7);
  const periodLabel = atlasMetalsHumanReadingPeriodLabel(days);
  const spot = days === 1;
  const allMode = atlasParallelMarketMetalsAllActive();

  if (allMode) {
    const comparison = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationComparison(days);
    title.textContent = `Comparaison des 5 métaux · ${periodLabel}`;
    period.textContent = `XAU · XAG · XPT · XPD · HG · ${periodLabel}`;
    source.textContent = spot
      ? "Comparaison Base 100 · Yahoo Finance Futures intraday · cinq séries séparées · aucune moyenne artificielle."
      : "Comparaison Base 100 · Yahoo Finance Futures · cinq séries séparées · aucune moyenne artificielle.";

    if (!comparison.complete) {
      card.dataset.state = "insufficient";
      state.textContent = `${comparison.count}/5 séries`;
      summary.textContent = "La comparaison globale attend les cinq historiques réels.";
      context.textContent = comparison.rows.map(row => (
        `${row.asset.symbol} : ${row.available ? atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(row.percent) : "non mesuré"}`
      )).join(" · ");
      setText(document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailDecision"), "Comparaison historique");
      return false;
    }

    const leaderMove = atlasMetalsHumanReadingMovement(
      comparison.leader?.percent
    );
    card.dataset.state = leaderMove.state;
    state.textContent = "Comparaison 5/5";
    summary.textContent =
      `Leader ${comparison.leader.asset.symbol} ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(comparison.leader.percent)}`
      + ` · retard ${comparison.laggard.asset.symbol} ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(comparison.laggard.percent)}`
      + ` · écart ${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
          minimumFractionDigits: 2,
          maximumFractionDigits: 2
        }).format(comparison.spread)} points.`;
    context.textContent = comparison.rows.map(row => (
      `${row.asset.symbol} ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(row.percent)}`
    )).join(" · ");
    setText(document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailDecision"), "Comparaison historique");
    return true;
  }

  const activeReading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, days);

  title.textContent = `${asset.name} · lecture sur ${periodLabel}`;
  period.textContent = `${asset.symbol} · ${periodLabel}`;
  source.textContent = spot
    ? "Historique Yahoo Finance Futures intraday · cotation Gold API distincte · observation uniquement, aucune prévision."
    : "Historique Yahoo Finance Futures · cotation Gold API distincte · observation uniquement, aucune prévision.";

  if (!activeReading) {
    card.dataset.state = "loading";
    state.textContent = "En attente";
    summary.textContent = "Historique public en cours de lecture.";
    context.textContent = "Aucune conclusion de remplacement n’est générée.";
    return false;
  }

  if (!activeReading.available) {
    card.dataset.state = activeReading.state || "insufficient";
    state.textContent = spot ? "En constitution" : "Insuffisant";
    summary.textContent = spot
      ? `La série Futures intraday 24 heures n’est pas encore disponible : ${activeReading.detail}.`
      : "Le nombre de séances disponibles ne permet pas une lecture historique fiable sur cette période.";
  } else {
    const movement = atlasMetalsHumanReadingMovement(activeReading.percent);
    card.dataset.state = movement.state;
    state.textContent = "Observation";
    summary.textContent = spot
      ? `${movement.sentence} sur 24 heures : ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(activeReading.percent)} sur ${activeReading.points} points Futures intraday.`
      : `${movement.sentence} sur ${periodLabel} : ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(activeReading.percent)} sur ${activeReading.points} séances Futures.`;
  }

  const horizonLabels = new Map([[7, "7 j"], [30, "30 j"], [90, "90 j"], [365, "1 an"]]);
  const horizonText = [7, 30, 90, 365].map(horizon => {
    const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, horizon);
    if (!reading.available) return `${horizonLabels.get(horizon)} : non mesuré`;
    return `${horizonLabels.get(horizon)} : ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingMovement(reading.percent).short}`;
  });
  context.textContent = horizonText.join(" · ");

  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailDecision"),
    "Observation historique"
  );
  return Boolean(activeReading.available);
}

### FUNCTION atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals
function atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);
  const allSeriesActive = atlasParallelMarketMetalsAllActive();

  const activeMetal = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal();

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metal-id]").forEach(button => {
    const active = selected.has(button.dataset.metalId);
    const focused = button.dataset.metalId === activeMetal.id;
    button.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
    button.classList.toggle("is-focus", focused);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
    button.setAttribute("aria-current", focused ? "true" : "false");
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metal-row]").forEach(row => {
    row.hidden = !selected.has(row.dataset.metalRow);
    row.classList.toggle(
      "is-focus",
      row.dataset.metalRow === activeMetal.id
    );
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metal-legend]").forEach(item => {
    const id = String(item.dataset.metalLegend || "");
    const active = selected.has(id);
    const focused = id === activeMetal.id;
    const asset = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.find(record => record.id === id);
    const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(id, metals.period);
    item.hidden = !active;
    item.classList.toggle("is-focus", focused && !allSeriesActive);
    item.classList.toggle("is-comparison", allSeriesActive);
    item.style.setProperty(
      "--atlas-metal-series-color",
      ATLAS_METALS_CHART_COLORS[id] || "#9fb3c2"
    );
    item.textContent = allSeriesActive && reading?.available
      ? `${asset?.symbol || id.toUpperCase()} ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(reading.percent)}`
      : asset?.symbol || id.toUpperCase();
    item.title = reading?.available
      ? `${asset?.name || id} · ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(reading.percent)} · cliquer pour revenir au prix réel`
      : `${asset?.name || id} · cliquer pour afficher le prix réel`;
  });

  const allSeriesButton = document.querySelector("[data-metals-all-series]");
  if (allSeriesButton) {
    allSeriesButton.classList.toggle("is-active", allSeriesActive);
    allSeriesButton.setAttribute(
      "aria-pressed",
      allSeriesActive ? "true" : "false"
    );
    allSeriesButton.textContent = allSeriesActive ? "TOUS 5/5" : "TOUS";
  }

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-period]").forEach(button => {
    const value = Number(button.dataset.metalsPeriod);
    const active = value === Number(metals.period);
    button.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
    const spotReading = value === 1
      ? atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id, 1)
      : null;
    button.classList.remove("is-unavailable");
    button.classList.toggle("is-building", value === 1 && spotReading?.available !== true);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
    if (value === 1) {
      button.title = spotReading?.available
        ? "Historique 24 h réel · Yahoo Finance Futures intraday"
        : `Intraday Futures en attente · ${spotReading?.detail || "première collecte GitHub Actions requise"}`;
      button.setAttribute(
        "aria-label",
        spotReading?.available
          ? "24 heures mesurées par Yahoo Finance Futures intraday"
          : "Historique Futures intraday 24 heures en attente"
      );
    }
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-view]").forEach(button => {
    const active = button.dataset.metalsView === metals.view;
    button.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-section]").forEach(button => {
    const active = button.dataset.metalsSection === metals.section;
    button.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-view-panel]").forEach(panel => {
    panel.hidden = panel.dataset.metalsViewPanel !== metals.section;
  });

  const assets = atlasParallelMarketSelectedMetals();
  const symbols = assets.map(asset => asset.symbol).join(" / ");
  const summary = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsSelectionSummary"
  );
  if (summary) {
    summary.textContent = assets.length
      ? `${assets.length} métal${assets.length > 1 ? "x" : ""} `
        + `sélectionné${assets.length > 1 ? "s" : ""} · ${symbols}`
      : "Aucun métal sélectionné";
  }

  const truth = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsFoundationTruth"
  );
  if (truth) {
    const quoteSummary = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary();
    truth.textContent = metals.section === "critical"
      ? "USGS préparé · import structurel non connecté"
      : `${metals.view === "base100" ? "Base 100" : "Prix"} · `
        + `${atlasChartPeriodLabel(metals.period)} · `
        + quoteSummary.truth;
  }

  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetalsDetail();
  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetalsMarket();
  atlasMarketRegistryRenderCatalog();
  if (atlasParallelMarketDomain() === "metals") renderAtlasMathCore();
}

function atlasParallelMarketRender() {
  const domain = atlasParallelMarketDomain();
  const metalsActive = domain === "metals";
  const analyst = document.getElementById("analyste");
  const switchButton = document.getElementById("atlasMarketDomainSwitch");

function atlasParallelMarketInit() {
  const switchButton = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMarketDomainSwitch"
  );
  const longPress = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMarketDomainLongPress"
  );
  const foundation = document.getElementById(
    "atlasParallelMarketFoundation"
  );
  const metalsMarketArea = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsMarketArea"
  );
  const metalsToolbar = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsUnifiedToolbar"
  );

  atlasParallelMarketMetalsRead();

  switchButton?.addEventListener("click", event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    atlasParallelMarketToggle("domain-badge");
  });

  longPress?.addEventListener("click", event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (atlasParallelMarketHoldConsumed) {
      atlasParallelMarketHoldConsumed = false;
    }
  });

  longPress?.addEventListener("pointerdown", event => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    atlasParallelMarketHoldConsumed = false;
    window.clearTimeout(atlasParallelMarketHoldTimer);
    atlasParallelMarketHoldTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      atlasParallelMarketHoldTimer = 0;
      atlasParallelMarketHoldConsumed = true;
      atlasParallelMarketToggle("title-long-press");
    }, ATLAS_PARALLEL_MARKET_HOLD_MS);
  });

  const cancelHold = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(atlasParallelMarketHoldTimer);
    atlasParallelMarketHoldTimer = 0;
  };

  longPress?.addEventListener("pointerup", cancelHold);
  longPress?.addEventListener("pointercancel", cancelHold);
  longPress?.addEventListener("pointerleave", cancelHold);

  longPress?.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
    if (event.shiftKe
--- END ---
